abstract: While the presence and distribution of galectin-1 and galectin-3 in different normal trophoblast cell populations is known, no information is available regarding their occurrence in malignant trophoblast of gestational trophoblastic disease (GTD). Galectins-1 and -3 have, however, been implicated in malignancies of other tissues. Immunoreactivity for these galectins in the transformed trophoblast of invasive mole (n = 8), choriocarcinoma (n = 7) and one case of placental site trophoblastic tumor (PSTT) was compared to that of the invasive trophoblast of the normal first trimester of pregnancy implantation sites (n = 9). A large proportion of the transformed trophoblast cells of all GTD studied were positive for galectin-1 and galectin-3. Immunoreactivity was scored semiquantitatively to include both the prevalence among the trophoblast cells and the intensity of staining. Immunoreactivity for both galectin-1 and galectin-3 in gestational trophoblastic disease is increased (significant differences at p < 0.05, Mann-Whitney Rank Sum Test). This finding may suggest a possible implication of galectins-1 and -3 in the invasiveness of the transformed trophoblastic cell, although the exact physiological significance of this finding remains to be determined.
abstract_ja: 悪性栄養膜細胞におけるガレクチン-1と-3の存在と分布は知られていない。ガレクチン-1と-3は他の臓器の悪性腫瘍への関与が報告されている。妊娠性絨毛性疾患（GTD）の形質転換した栄養膜細胞における両ガレクチンの免疫反応性を、侵入奇胎（8例）、絨毛癌（7例）、胎盤部トロホブラスト腫瘍（1例）で評価し、正常初期妊娠の着床部位の浸潤性栄養膜（9例）と比較した。検討したすべてのGTDで、形質転換した栄養膜細胞の多くが両ガレクチンに陽性だった。免疫反応性は、陽性細胞の割合と染色強度の両方を含めて半定量的にスコア化した。妊娠性絨毛性疾患におけるガレクチン-1および-3の免疫反応性は増加していた（Mann-Whitney順位和検定、p<0.05）。この所見は、形質転換した栄養膜細胞の浸潤能へのガレクチン-1および-3の関与を示唆する可能性があるが、その正確な生理学的意義は未確定である。
